x: The Shippens soon met up with Ron Wyld and helped him to celebrate his 60th birthday along with other guests Dave Scott, Joy Gardener (Pete's mother), and Scott Wyld and almost before Clive's feet had touched the floor he was being inveigled into helping to coach pole vault at Homebush Stadium.

Pete Willis had tried everything to ensure that he got an A team berth, trying to run away from Will in the National Cross, running a tough 5 miler the previous weekend in an attempt to impress - and he got his wish.
Last man into the SEAA team at Milton Keynes, Pete Willis was raided from the Bs here at Sutton Park to plug the gap caused by the removal of Paul Freary from the line-up.
